# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and Skia m151 stability** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers significant managed-layer performance gains on top of the stable Skia m151 engine. Multiple hot paths — color conversion, HarfBuzz text shaping, hex parsing, SKShaper glyph reads — are ported to allocation-free managed C#. A native resource leak in SKImage is fixed, and WASM builds gain Emscripten 5.0.6 support for .NET 11.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 stability fixes** — Multiple upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs land in the stable release, hardening the engine across rendering, text, and GPU paths. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse now accept `ReadOnlySpan<char>` directly, avoiding a string allocation on hot parsing paths. The internal hex decoder is also faster. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — A native handle was leaked when decoding an encoded image cropped with an SKRectI. The path now correctly releases the temporary resource on failure. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color math ported to allocation-free managed C#** — SKColor↔SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply are now pure managed integer math, eliminating the P/Invoke round-trip on every color operation. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **HarfBuzz text shaping and tag parsing go allocation-free** — `Buffer.AddUtf8(string)` uses a pooled UTF-8 encoder instead of allocating a byte array, `Tag.Parse` and `SKFourByteTag.Parse` eliminate per-call `char[4]` allocations, and `SKShaper` reads glyph results via zero-copy spans. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **unsafe modifier removed from GRContextOptions** — An unnecessary `unsafe` modifier is cleaned up from `GRContextOptions`, reducing the unsafe code surface. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Platform

- **WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 native slices are added so SkiaSharp runs on the upcoming .NET 11 WebAssembly runtime without modification. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release. The allocation-free `Buffer.AddUtf8` pooled encoder and the zero-alloc `Tag.Parse` path make high-frequency shaping loops measurably faster.
